main_text.p: plura in hac conjugatione reperias. Hithp. Præt. הִתְעַנָּה [?] Afflictus est: הִתְעַנִּית [?] Afflictus es, vel Afflixisti te, 1.Reg.2.26. Infinit. לְהִתְעַנּוֹת [?] Ut affligeremus nos, Esra 8.21. Imper. הִתְעַנִּי [?] Demitte te, Gen.16.19.
עָנִי [?] m. Mansuetus, Humilis, Numer.12.3. Plur. עֲנָיִים [?] Mansueti, Psal.10.17. Constr. עֲנֵי [?] Soph.2.3.
עֲנָוָה [?] f. Mansuetudo, Abjectio, Humilitas, Prov.15.33.
עָנוָה [?] f. Idem, Psal.45.5. Aff. וַעֲנוָתְךָ [?] Et mansuetudo tua, Psal.18.36. pro quo legitur וַעֲנָתְךָ [?] 2.Sam.22.36.

עָנִי [?] m. Affliĉtus, Pauper, Deut.24.12. Aff. לְעָנְיְךָ [?] Ergà pauperem tuum: Plur. עֲנִיִּים [?] Pauperes, Job.34.28. Constr. עָנֵי [?] Job.24.4. Aff. וַעֲנִיֵּי [?] Et pauperum suorum, Jes.49.13. Chald. עֲנִי [?] Afflicti, Dan.4.24. Fœm. עֲנִיָּה [?] Pauper-cula, Jefa.10.v.13.

עָנִי [?] m. Affliĉtio, Pauperitas: עָנִי רָאָה עָנִי [?] Expertus est afflictionem, Thren.3.1. In paulâ, עָנִי [?] Deuter.16.3. Aff. עָנְיִי [?] Afflictionis meæ, Genef.41.52. עָנְיָם [?] Afflictionem eorum, Ezech.4.v.31.
עָנוֹת [?] f.p. Sulci, juxta Aben Efram, quasi idem quod מְעָנִית [?] quod sequitur: לִשְׁתֵּי עִינֹתָם [?] In duobus sulcis suis, Hos.10.10. Vide suprà in עָוָה [?] in Nomine עַיִן [?].
עָנְיָן [?] m. Occupatio, Negotium, molestum proprie, quod hominem affligit, Eccles.1.13. Constr. עִנְיַן [?] Eccles.4.v.8. & 5.v.13.
תַּעֲנִית [?] f. Jejunium, ab Affligendo: Aff. קִמְּתִי מִתַּעֲנִיתִי [?] Surrexi à jejunio meo, Efr.9.5.
לְמַעַן [?] Ut, Propter; huc quidam reducunt, quasi causæ reditionem & Responsionem denotet. Vide in מַעַן [?].
יַעֲנָה יְעָנָה [?] f. Ulula, avis deserta incolens, à voce Resonante sic dicta, Jes.13.21. Plurale ex forma altera; יְעֲנִים [?] Ululæ, Thren.4.3. LXX. Struthionem reddunt.

page.notes: Hebrew words are doubtful throughout and marked [?] where the scan is faint or broken. The running head "ענ" is Hebrew and uncertain. Some Latin abbreviations, such as "Efr.9.5", are copied as printed. Faint marks in the lower part of the page are damage, not text.
